artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: New script: ONE additive conditional update per row, SET instrument_kind = <fund|single_security> WHERE attribute_not_exists(instrument_kind), touching no other attribute; refuses (KindAlreadySet) any row already carrying instrument_kind; refuses (UnknownKind) before any write attempt for a kind outside the contract's two values, never defaulting. --source constituents derives its plan from the served ETF constituents feed via seed-etf-constituents.py's own load_constituents()/instrument_kind_for(), never bd-securities. CLI runs --dry-run only in this build (no live-write path exercised). Live scan this build: table_rows_at_build=2309, rows_absent_kind=2163, would_set=156, defaulted=0.

Adds the order's step-2 kind-only mode: set_kind_only_if_absent() (same conditional-update shape as set-instrument-kind.py, kept local so the constituents seeder needs no sibling-script import) and a new --kind-only CLI flag that plans, for every constituent ticker with a determinate instrument_kind_for() value, ONE conditional SET instrument_kind on attribute_not_exists(instrument_kind) -- regardless of the row's current classified_by, and touching no other attribute. Run --dry-run only in this build.

7 tests: only instrument_kind changes in the UpdateExpression/ConditionExpression/ExpressionAttributeValues (asserted verbatim, no other attribute name in the call, on both set-instrument-kind.py's and the constituents seeder's kind-only mode); a row that already has instrument_kind raises KindAlreadySet and is never overwritten (both call sites); an unknown kind raises UnknownKind before any update_item call (table.calls == []); plan_absent_kind excludes rows that already carry the attribute; rows_from_constituents_feed excludes a ticker whose kind is undetermined (a cash-residual line). python -m pytest infra/aws/lambda/v2_portal/_shared/tests/test_set_instrument_kind.py -q -p no:cacheprovider: 7 passed in 0.30s.

Amendment 1 (row MDPF_SECCLASS-W5-S1): test_constituent_seeder_never_sets_classified_by (the round-1, RULING-103050 assertion the four-label C-WRITER contract retired) replaced with test_constituent_seeder_sets_constituents_label_and_refuses_seed_or_scheduled, asserting row['classified_by'] == 'constituents' on a written row and RowProtected on a seed-labelled ticker (AAPL) and a scheduled-labelled ticker (JPM) alike. No other assertion in the file touched. python -m pytest infra/aws/lambda/v2_portal/_shared/tests/test_seed_fields.py -q -p no:cacheprovider: 19 passed in 0.23s (was 1 failed, 18 passed before this edit).

Built from set-instrument-kind.py --dry-run --source constituents against the live table (one fully-paginated scan, read-only). table_rows_at_build=2309, rows_absent_kind=2163, would_set=156, defaulted=0, from_bd_securities=1970 (excluded per Andrew-direct 2026-09-30 ~02:2xZ: a bd-securities value may seed a NEW row, never write into an existing one -- every absent-kind row here is existing). source_named names the ETF constituents feed (served artifact, path + coverage stated). rows[] lists the 156 {ticker, instrument_kind, source} entries (154 single_security + 2 fund).
